messages:
maria_g: quick handoff — token-cost attribution snapshot is available in GCS gs://redwood-telemetry/snapshots/2175483210.csv. schema changes: renamed `tokens` -> `token_count`, added `model_variant` and `route`. need owners to validate latency mapping (per-route p50/p95) and confirm streaming mapping. @kyle_h @eng-runtime

telemetry-bot: export job completed 2175483200 — rows: 1,234,567. preview: gs://redwood-telemetry/previews/2175483210.jsonl

kyle_h: I'll take validation ownership for model_variant+route. will run smoke tests tomorrow morning. can someone drop a tiny sample (10 rows) to /tmp for quick checks?

ajohnson: adding expected sample rates to the GH PR — recommend 1% sampling for full export to avoid spiking analytics. I'll attach sampling config.

sasha_p: created GH issue #432 listing missing attrs (user_agent, client_type) and examples of malformed events. flagged streaming mapping gap there.

eng-runtime: noted. streaming events currently surface `event.stream_meta`. propose mapping `stream_meta.model` -> `model_variant`. also KV-cache-backed requests don't include `route` in the envelope right now.

kyle_h: perfect — i'll write a tiny transform for the interim. sample jq snippet: `jq '.event | {model_variant: (.stream_meta.model // .model), token_count: .token_count, route: .route}'`

maria_g: timeline: validation by Fri, canary rollout Mon. blockers: need eng-runtime confirmation on KV-cache route addition by EOD so we can close the schema gap.

eng-runtime: we'll add `route` to KV cache envelope in the next deploy, target EOD PT. cc @ravi for scheduling.

ravi: noted, scheduling deploy slot at 17:00 PT today. i'll post the deploy-bot message when queued.

telemetry-bot: deploy scheduled: canary window 17:00-18:00 PT 2026-03-17.

kyle_h: ok i'll run the smoke tests immediately after canary and report p50/p95 diffs. ping here if anything breaks :thumbsup:
